basic_details.job_title: RCB Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Research Associate I, Field Assistant Posts

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 35 Years Age relaxation will be applicable as per government rules. | Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

qualification.details: Research Associate I: PhD in Biotechnology / Biochemistry / Microbiology / Plant Biology / Bioengineering / Agricultural Microbiology / Life Sciences from a recognized university. Should have strong experience in design and development of research experiments related to plant physiology, functional biology with at least one first authored research paper in SCI journal. Field Assistant: Bachelor's degree (B.Sc./B.Tech.) or Diploma in Agriculture / Life Sciences / Environmental Science or related field. Basic knowledge of field experiments and agricultural practices. Candidate with experience in handling field trials, crop management, and soil sampling. Familiarity with greenhouse work, irrigation practices, and fertilizer application. Exposure to basic lab techniques sample preparation, weighing, data recording).

salary_details.details: Research Associate I: Rs.58,000/- + 30% HRA Field Assistant: Rs.18,000/- + 30% HRA

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RCB Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RCB to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: RCB Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the RCB Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download RCB Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: RCB Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Research Associate I and 1 for Field Assistant.

content_sections.heading: RCB Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Associate I: PhD in Biotechnology / Biochemistry / Microbiology / Plant Biology / Bioengineering / Agricultural Microbiology / Life Sciences from a recognized university. Should have strong experience in design and development of research experiments related to plant physiology, functional biology with at least one first authored research paper in SCI journal. Field Assistant: Bachelor's degree (B.Sc./B.Tech.) or Diploma in Agriculture / Life Sciences / Environmental Science or related field. Basic knowledge of field experiments and agricultural practices. Candidate with experience in handling field trials, crop management, and soil sampling. Familiarity with greenhouse work, irrigation practices, and fertilizer application. Exposure to basic lab techniques sample preparation, weighing, data recording).

content_sections.heading: RCB Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 Years Age relaxation will be applicable as per government rules. Candidates should ensure that they fulfill the prescribed age criteria. Calculate your exact age using our Age Calculator before submitting your application to confirm your eligibility.

content_sections.heading: RCB Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Research Associate I: Rs.58,000/- + 30% HRA Field Assistant: Rs.18,000/- + 30% HRA

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RCB Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RCB to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Research Associate I & Field Assistant posts is 27th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in RCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Research Associate I and Field Assistant positions at the Regional Centre for Biotechnology.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Field Assistant post?
faq.answer: For the Field Assistant position, candidates need a Bachelor's degree (B.Sc./B.Tech.) or a Diploma in Agriculture, Life Sciences, or Environmental Science.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Research Associate I post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate I post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Research Associate I position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate I post will receive a salary of Rs.58,000/- plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on an Online Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for RCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for RCB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply for these posts through the online mode only.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Regional Centre for Biotechnology located?
faq.answer: The Regional Centre for Biotechnology is located in Faridabad, Haryana, with the pincode 121001.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is 27/Project/2026/HR.
